name: step
description: Step frame. Records one unit of agent execution. See spec/sbtrace-v1.md §6.3 and §6.5. The body is one of two encodings: plain (body.step is the step object) or compressed (body.encoding='gzip+base64', body.data is base64-of-gzip of the step object's canonical-JSON).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Frame discriminator.

fields.name: step
fields.description: Plain encoding: the canonical-JSON form of the recorded step (see step body schema). MUST be present iff 'encoding' is absent.

fields.name: encoding
fields.description: Compressed encoding tag. MUST only appear when the header declared compression='gzip+dedup-2'.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Base64 of the gzipped canonical-JSON encoding of the step object. MUST be present iff 'encoding' is present.

fields.name: step_id
fields.description: ULID, monotonic per trace. Inside the step body.

fields.name: step_kind
fields.description: Step kind discriminator. Unknown values are passed through unchanged for forward compatibility.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable label (model id, tool name, ...).

fields.name: parent_step_id
fields.description: Parent edge in the call tree. Null for the root.

fields.name: parent_step_ids
fields.description: Multi-parent edges (parallel_branch_join only).

fields.name: inputs
fields.description: Canonical-JSON-encodable input payload.

fields.name: outputs
fields.description: Canonical-JSON-encodable output payload.

fields.name: inputs_hash
fields.description: sha256:<hex> over canonical_json(inputs).

fields.name: outputs_hash
fields.description: sha256:<hex> over canonical_json(outputs).

fields.name: nondeterminism
fields.description: Recorded non-deterministic inputs (rng seeds, wallclock, env, network, model_provider).

fields.name: nondeterminism_hash
fields.description: sha256:<hex> over canonical_json(nondeterminism).

fields.name: wallclock_ns
fields.description: Step wallclock at write time, ns since Unix epoch.

fields.name: cpu_ns
fields.description: Cumulative CPU time consumed by this step, in ns.

fields.name: cost_usd
fields.description: Cost from pinned price_list_version, in USD.

fields.name: llm_request
fields.description: Exact LLM request dict (model, messages, sampling params, tool spec).

fields.name: llm_response
fields.description: Exact LLM response dict.

fields.name: tool_name
fields.description: Tool identifier (only for tool_call / mcp_call).

fields.name: policy_decision
fields.description: Enforcement / audit decision payload.

fields.name: router_decision
fields.description: Router decision payload.

fields.name: branch_id
fields.description: Identifier for parallel branches; set on parallel_branch_open and steps inside the branch.

fields.name: branch_ids
fields.description: Branch ids being joined.

fields.name: exception
fields.description: Exception payload (type, message, traceback).

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Free-form recorder metadata. Opaque to the spec.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Free-form string tags. Opaque to the spec.

extension_ranges.description: Reserved for the SB-Trace spec. Frame envelope ids live at 1-9; step body ids start at 10.
Step fields owned by a registered capability (e.g. retrieval-context, observability span ids, formal-verification annotations).
Vendor-private step fields. Readers MUST ignore unknown experimental ids; writers SHOULD declare an advisory capability frame to document them.
